newsitem.title: USA: Guarantee Life adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Guarantee Life adopts rights plan.

text.p: The Guarantee Life Cos Inc said Friday the company adopted a shareholder rights plan to ensure fair treatment for shareholders in the event of a hostile takeover bid.
The company said the plan was not adopted in response to any specific effort to gain control of Guarantee Life.

Under the plan, shareholders of record on November 29 will receive one right to preferred stock for each share of common share owned. The rights are exercisable if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's voting shares. Rights held by the 15 percent shareholder then become void.
